ayahs.1: Bahut baa-barkat hai woh (Allah) jis ke haath mein baadshahi hai aur jo har cheez par qudrat rakhne wala hai.
ayahs.2: Jis ne maut aur hayaat ko is liye paida kiya ke tumhein aazmaaye ke tum mein se achchhe kaam kaun karta hai, aur woh Ghaalib (aur) bakhshne wala hai.
ayahs.3: Jis ne saat aasman oopar tale banaaye. (To ae dekhne wale) Allah Rahman ki paidaish mein koi be-zaabitagee na dekhega, dobaara (nazrein daal kar) dekh le kya koi shigaaf bhi nazar aa raha hai.
ayahs.4: Phir dohra kar do do baar dekh le teri nigah teri taraf zaleel (o-aajiz) ho kar thaki hui laut aayegi.
ayahs.5: Beshak hum ne aasmaan-e-dunya ko charaaghon (sitaaron) se aaraasta kiya aur unhein shaitaanon ke maarne ka zariya bana diya aur shaitaanon ke liye hum ne (dozakh ka jalaane wala) azaab tayyaar kar diya.
ayahs.6: Aur apne Rabb ke saath kufr karne walon ke liye jahannam ka azaab hai aur woh kya hi buri jagah hai.
ayahs.7: Jab is mein yeh daale jaayenge to is ki bade zor ki aawaz sunenge aur woh josh maar rahi hogi.
ayahs.8: Qareeb hai ke (abhi) ghusse ke maare phat jaaye, jab kabhi is mein koi giroh daala jaayega is se jahannam ke daaroghe poochhenge ke kya tumhare paas daraane wala koi nahin aaya tha?
ayahs.9: Woh jawaab denge ke beshak aaya tha lekin hum ne use jhutlaaya aur hum ne kaha ke Allah Taala ne kuchh bhi naazil nahin farmaaya. Tum bahut badi gumraahi mein hi ho.
ayahs.10: Aur kahenge agar hum sunte hote ya aql rakhte hote to dozakhiyon mein (shareek) na hote.
ayahs.11: Pas unhon ne apne jurm ka iqbaal kar liya. Ab yeh dozakhi dafa hon (door hon).
ayahs.12: Beshak jo log apne Parwardigaar se ghaibaana taur par darte rehte hain un ke liye bakhshish hai aur bada sawaab hai.
ayahs.13: Tum apni baaton ko chhupaao ya zaahir karo woh to seenon ki posheedgi ko bhi bakhoobi jaanta hai.
ayahs.14: Kya wohi na jaane jis ne paida kiya? Phir woh bareek-been aur bakhabar bhi ho.
ayahs.15: Woh zaat jis ne tumhare liye zameen ko past-o-mutee kar diya taake tum is ki raahon mein chalte phirte raho aur Allah ki roziyan khaao (piyo) isi ki taraf (tumhein) jee kar uth khada hona hai.
ayahs.16: Kya tum is baat se be-khauf ho gaye ho ke aasmanon wala tumhein zameen mein dhansa de aur achaanak zameen larazne lage.
ayahs.17: Ya kya tum is baat se nidar ho gaye ho ke aasmanon wala tum par patthar barsa de? Phir to tumhein maloom ho hi jaayega ke mera daraana kaisa tha.
ayahs.18: Aur un se pehle logon ne bhi jhutlaaya tha to dekho un par mera azaab kaisa kuchh hua?
ayahs.19: Kya yeh apne oopar par khole hue aur (kabhi kabhi) samete hue (udne wale) parindon ko nahin dekhte, unhein (Allah) Rahman hi (hawaa-o-faza mein) thaame hue hai. Beshak har cheez is ki nigah mein hai.
ayahs.20: Siwaaye Allah ke tumhara woh kaun sa lashkar hai jo tumhari madad kar sake kaafir to sarasar dhoke hi mein hain.
ayahs.21: Agar Allah Taala apni rozi rok le to bataao kaun hai jo phir tumhein rozi dega? Balke (kaafir) to sarkashi aur bidakne par ad gaye hain.
ayahs.22: Achchha woh shakhs ziyaada hidayat wala hai jo apne munh ke bal aundha ho kar chale ya woh jo seedha (pairon ke bal) raah-e-raast par chala ho?
ayahs.23: Keh dijiye ke wohi (Allah) hai jis ne tumhein paida kiya aur tumhare kaan aankhein aur dil banaaye tum bahut hi kam shukar-guzaari karte ho.
ayahs.24: Keh dijiye! Ke wohi hai jis ne tumhein zameen mein phaila diya aur is ki taraf se tum ikatthe kiye jaaoge.
ayahs.25: (Kaafir) poochhte hain ke woh waada kab zaahir hoga agar tum sachche ho (to bataao?)
ayahs.26: Aap keh dijiye ke is ka ilm to Allah hi ko hai, main to sirf khule taur par aagah kar dene wala hoon.
ayahs.27: Jab yeh log is waade ko qareeb-tar paa lenge is waqt un kaafiron ke chehre bigad jaayenge aur keh diya jaayega ke yehi hai jise tum talab kiya karte the.
ayahs.28: Aap keh dijiye! Achchha agar mujhe aur mere saathiyon ko Allah Taala halaak kar de ya hum par rahm kare (bahar-soorat yeh to bataao) ke kaafiron ko dardnaak azaab se kaun bachaayega?
ayahs.29: Aap keh dijiye! Ke wohi Rahman hai hum to is par imaan laa chuke aur isi par hamara bharosa hai. Tumhein anqareeb maloom ho jaayega ke sareeh gumraahi mein kaun hai?
ayahs.30: Aap keh dijiye! Ke achchha yeh to bataao ke agar tumhare (peene ka) paani zameen mein utar jaaye to kaun hai jo tumhare liye nithra hua paanee laaye?
